description: The CUSTOM / OTHER option matrix. Everything past the top-10 stock list lives here.
design_principle: NR-13 - automate stock, then stop. Do NOT enumerate or price every permutation of these options. This matrix exists so the estimator can describe a custom line precisely, not so the copilot can price one.
keying_note: Keying is handled inside the lock options - interchangeable core (small or large format), storeroom lock with IC, keyway - and is architect-specified. There is no separate keying-schedule workflow in CBC bid sets (Matrix 7.6, partial).
hard_manual_triggers: custom sizes such as 9 ft doors
options not sold in years (e.g. electric latch retraction in a given model/size/finish)
any item with no catalog price
